note: DEV-ONLY proxy constants for the per-round loop. BAKED here (root:root 0600, unreadable by the solver's dropped uid) and read from THIS FILE ONLY. Contains NO calibrated anchor (strong_baseline_ce / ref_speedup), NO held-out corpus: the per-round signal is the RAW adaptation gain (base_ce - candidate_ce) on the PUBLIC dev corpus /data/datasets/a8_syscode/val.txt, never normalised against the graded anchor. The graded score is produced after the session by the runner from a freshly-uploaded /tests over the HIDDEN held-out split, normalising the gain against the hidden strong_baseline_ce through the calibrated log curve; this loop only decides WHICH snapshot is graded.
dev_corpus_note: the PUBLIC dev corpus the solver already has (/data/datasets/a8_syscode/val.txt). The GRADED held-out corpus (tests/holdout_corpus.txt) is uploaded fresh at scoring and is NOT in this image; the dev gain is measured on the public split only.
byte_budget_note: the DECLARED-file byte gate (adapter.bin + adapter_entry.py) is enforced exactly as the grade's disclosed rule. 🔴 The grade ALSO runs a whole-filesystem stash sweep + quarantine that this dev proxy does NOT reproduce (it is heavy and its inventory is graded-surface), so a candidate that stashes bytes outside the declared files can pass the dev byte gate and still fail the grade's sweep.
dev_eval_tokens_note: REDUCED public-corpus CE budget for the per-round loop (65,536 tokens vs the graded 196,608), eval-only (no training in the candidate path, matching the grade). A per-round pass is two forward-only CE evals of the 0.5B base model — well under a minute on H20.
